item.title: 'Source available' is not open source (and that's okay)
item.description:
📝 He followed with "Open source is when the source is open. He argued that you can't ignore the Open Source Initiative definition. That is defensible and generous, but it is not open source.

item.title: Dependable C
item.description:
📝 This mean that code written in C can be modified by a larger pool of programmers. Who values writing code that is guaranteed to compile and work correctly, over having the latest language features. However in some very rare occasions, this guide will highlight where writing code that is technically UB is permitted, because in practice it is dependable.
🔗 Read more: https://dependablec.org/
